Privacy policy

Last updated: 9 October 2026

This policy follows the Law of Ukraine «Про захист персональних даних» (No. 2297-VI) and, for people in the European Union, the GDPR.

1. Who we are

cab is run by the NGO Debate Federation of Ukraine (ВМГО «Федерація Дебатів України»). Address: [legal address]. ЄДРПОУ: [code].

2. What we store and why

Your account. When you sign in with GitHub or Google we receive and keep your name, e-mail address, picture link and your account number there.

Guests. If you register without an account we keep the name you enter and a personal link to that one session.

Feedback on adjudicators. After a room's ballot is in, each team can send one feedback on its adjudicator: two scores from 1 to 10 and a written discussion, kept with the debate's results. The team that sent it and the club head see it with the team's name; the adjudicator sees it without the team's name once the club head finishes the session. Everyone sees each adjudicator's average, where a base of 5 counts as one vote.

3. Cookies and browser storage

One cookie keeps you signed in. cab uses no analytics, no advertising and no third-party trackers.
